result.title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
result.summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\times$ more training-loop time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为异构多智能体系统提出 assume/guarantee 契约框架（AGC-MAS）及 IHA-MARL 算法，将团队任务分解为带自动机、超时与成功率要求的子任务契约，并交替进行契约分配、单智能体训练与能力评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 契约把子任务的前提假设、成功判据与自动机进度监控显式化，可能为 LVR 中分段推理的状态接口、停止与验证提供概念参照；但其多智能体控制语境与视觉推理距离较远，可供核查迁移价值。
